The flight has ended (line items stopped at 2027-07-09 23:00 UTC as scheduled). Here's the recap.

## Glimberpay Market Wallet — campaign recap (27 Jun – 9 Jul 2027, UK time)

**Setup:** One campaign ("Glimberpay Market Wallet — Installs") with two ad groups, both targeting the UK on iOS and Android only, optimizing for website conversions against the verified "Wallet installed" pixel tag, £-free ALL_ON_TWITTER placement, billed to the USD Amex. Only your 5 supplied posts were promoted; no new copy was written. Budget: $400 total, split across line items with daily caps totalling ~$30.76/day.

**Results (summed over the two reporting windows; installs = "Wallet installed" web conversions):**

| Metric | Direct/value group (posts …9840, …4346, …0864) | Playful/urgency group (…3080, …9029) | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spend | ~$99.26 | ~$297.71 | **~$396.97** |
| Impressions | 86,885 | 292,804 | **379,689** |
| Link clicks | 35 | 210 | **245** |
| Installs ("Wallet installed") | 4 | 16 | **20** |

**What worked:** The playful/urgency creative consistently outperformed — post …3080 ("Bought the bread. Found the cheese. Lost the receipt…") and post …9029 ("9 July is the last day…") drove ~2.3x the link clicks and 4x the installs of the direct/value group, at a better cost per install. I shifted budget toward that group on 30 Jun and again on 3 Jul, then paused the direct/value ad group on 8 Jul and moved its budget to the playful/urgency group for the final days. The direct/value posts (especially …9840, zero installs) lagged throughout. Overall cost ≈ $19.85 per reported install.

**Notes & caveats:**
- Install counts are pixel-attributed web conversions ("Wallet installed", DOWNLOAD tag, 14-day click / 1-day view window); post-view installs were a minority (≈4 of 20).
- Spend came in just under the $400 cap (~$397).
- Both ad groups have now ended as scheduled; the direct/value group was paused early. Nothing is left serving or accruing spend.
- Financial-services approval for the UK was already in place and no policy issues arose; targeting stayed UK + iOS/Android only, matching product availability.
- Honest read: click-through (~0.06%) and install volume are modest — the creative that leaned into the market-day story and the 9 July deadline worked best, which is the clearest signal for any future flight.
